svg.title: TabICL v2 - classifier
svg.desc: soda-inria - column set transformer -> row encoder -> in-context stack · 27.6 M parameters. Symbols in shapes: B: ensemble members (batch); n: rows in the context (train + test); p: raw features; F: feature groups; E: embedding width; n_test: test rows (the rows being predicted). Abbreviations: ICL: in-context learning: test rows attend to the labelled training rows; CLS: learned summary token that reads out a row or column; RoPE: rotary position embedding; MLP: multilayer perceptron (the feed-forward sublayer); GELU: Gaussian error linear unit (activation); LayerNorm: layer normalisation; KV: keys and values (as in KV cache, KV heads). How to read: × N: the block is stacked N times; over rows / columns / features: the axis this block's attention runs across; dot: the parameters in that stage, on a log scale; the axis runs from the smallest dot to the largest; % is the stage's share of the total; hollow dot: one sublayer's parameters; "/ block" counts one copy of a stacked block; margin colour: the phase, from first (dark) to last (light); output shape: the tensor each stage emits, in the symbols above.
